content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

The Sovereign Stack is a no-KYC, no-censorship, and no-fee payment gateway solution designed specifically for digital sellers in restricted markets. By using NOWPayments and the power of crypto, you can process payments directly on your website without relying on third-party platforms that charge exorbitant fees. The Sovereign Stack is built to provide a seamless and transparent payment experience, ensuring that your customers can buy your digital products with ease while you retain full control over your revenue streams.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Stack's architecture is built around a decentralized and transparent payment processing system that integrates seamlessly with your existing website. By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script as the backend logic, you can process payments in real-time and update your order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. The NOWPayments gateway handles payment verification and automatic crypto pricing in USD, converted at transaction time. This means that you can focus on creating digital products while the Sovereign Stack takes care of the payment processing and delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Sovereign Stack is designed specifically for digital sellers who face restrictions on payment processing in their countries or regions. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, the Sovereign Stack provides a flexible and scalable solution that allows you to collect payments in crypto without relying on platform fees. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can take control of your revenue streams and focus on growing your business.
With the Sovereign Stack, you can say goodbye to platform fees and hello to instant scalability and full data ownership.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Stack consists of five core components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is carefully selected to provide a seamless and transparent payment experience that integrates with your existing website.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the Sovereign Stack, start by choosing your preferred components and configuring them to work together. Next, integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend logic and order storage solutions. Finally, set up automatic crypto pricing in USD and configure your payment verification webhook. With the Sovereign Stack, you can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in just a few hours and start collecting payments in crypto without relying on platform fees.
